reviews.title: Don't use Swoop.
reviews.text: I never write reviews, but this time, Swoop was an absolutely terrible experience for me. We arrived before boarding time ( at least 1 hour before), but they didn't accept us. They told me that we don't have US visas ( 2 months ago, we already go to the US before). So, we checked the visa again, still, it was valid. Also, the customer service was terrible. The lady at the front was so annoying. Therefore, We couldn't take the airline. Never book here, guys !!!
reviews.author: Hera

reviews.title: Completely normal experience
reviews.text: First, I love the bundled pricing options. I paid $350 for two return tickets and a checked bag each way from Toronto to Halifax. Great price! Second, when I booked my ticket, I accidentally booked two checked bags to Halifax, instead of one to and one back. I contacted them, and as with all airlines you can make changes for free within 24hrs of booking. I was helped and got my adjusted booking confirmation within minutes. And finally, I am surprised at the amount of people who claim Swoop has hidden fees. All the fees are clear from the beginning and you get a chance to book bags, seats etc at lower costs if you pay up front. Our flights were on time, everything was fine. Completely normal experience. And they have a pretty good cup of coffee on board for $3. Thanks to the Swooper nice team who staffed our flights.
reviews.author: Stacey-Lee W

reviews.title: Announced 30 min delay that took 2.5 hours
reviews.text: Avoid this airline if reaching on time is important. Customer support is non-existent and unhelpful if you can reach it. After on-time boarding, my flight moved towards the runway but came back. The pilot announced that the A/C and pressure system had an issue that would take 30 to 40 mins. However, there was no update after that time elapsed. Then, he announced it would take another 10-15 mins. Then another 10-15 mins. The delay kept increasing and the uncertainty made it impossible to make any change. I finally disembarked the flight because I had missed the appointment for which I was traveling.
reviews.author: Atif Majeed

reviews.title: Be very careful
reviews.text: If you are looking into Swoop or have used them before. You will most likely know about how ever service is an add on. I am fine with this because it is what it is. But, when checking in at the Abbotsford airport. The agent informed us we had not correctly paid for our carry ons. We were a group of three with only two of us having carry ons. I conceded that I may have made the oversight and paid $160 on the spot. Later though, I reviewed my itinerary and online receipt and I had paid for the two carry ons. So, I sent an email to them with an explanation. Long story short - they will not refund me. Be very careful when travelling with them.
reviews.author: R B

reviews.title: The Worst Customer Service
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs! The customer service is absolutely terrible. Companies like swoop are the reason travel has become so stressful in Canada. They lie and scam. I was midway through my flight when they had mechanical issues on board and returned to the original airport. They had absolutely no other flight options to get my to my destination within the next 72 hours. You can't call and speak to anyone and we were told at the airport to just go home by Swoop employees. We were told we got flight and hotel coverage through email and now swoop won't reimburse. They also couldn't do anything about my return flight that was impossible to take because they never got me to my destination. Have never had such a bad experience with an airline, and will never use them again!
reviews.author: Emily H

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: When we were leaving from Toronto there was no information given before we came to the airport. We had to struggle to find a way to print a ticket and no information was given to us to prepare for the departure. We had to ask the staff so many times to guide us. Swoop never mentioned they were planning a strike until after we arrived at the resort. They sent an email saying that the flight may be cancelled the same day we arrived to the resort. This ruined our trip because we were worrying about the possible flight cancellation on top of that SWOOPs “phone service” does not answer your calls. After that they sent us a cancellation the day before we were supposed to leave (Thursday) and did not arrange another flight. Again we could not contact them. Since they did not give us information we went to our original flight time to PUNTA CANA AIRPORT. And the air assist plus SWOOP staff did not help us at all. They said they did not have information for us and we’re not willing to even make a phone call to SWOOP which they are able to do because they have other connections. While we were talking to the air assist staff we put our bags down and someone stole money from our purse. Too many security guards were there and still someone stole money in broad daylight. We even complained to them and they did nothing about it. Due to SWOOPS ignorance and unprofessional service we ended up losing money and paying for another flight at a higher place. We didn’t want to stay in the airport as we felt unsafe in the airport. This is the worse service we encountered in our whole life. And we will never fly with SWOOP or WEST JET ever again.
reviews.author: Mathy B

reviews.title: Damaged luggage
reviews.text: The airline took great care of me after my luggage was damaged. When I returned and found my suitcase looked like it was used for football practice, swoop immediately took charge! They put a claim in, and before the end of the next month they sent me a new one. I'm still waiting for air Canada to replace my suitcase from 5 years ago, so I'm happy with swoop.
reviews.author: Jay S

reviews.title: Flight cancelation
reviews.text: Flight canceled because of strike....horrible customer service from Swoop and Westjet. Had flight booked for a Convention and with last minute cancelation i am being chrged for my hotel room....what will Swoop do, nothing becaue the pilots and all staff only think about themselves. Maybe our fearless PM Trudeau should do something but he's useless as well....thanks Swoop for your really screwed up service...
reviews.author: Frank S

reviews.title: Worst airline scheduling ever
reviews.text: Swoop airlines cheated us of a complete 1st day as we checked into our hotel at 115 am the 15th, left 9n the14th. Return flight was even worse, we were in line to get checked in for 4 hours 15 mins. Then we were locked in the departure area for 4 hours 45 mins. We were 8 hours behind return time. Terrible experence!!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: Alexander C

reviews.title: Not Good
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled with no information on what to do. No one answered my call or respond for 4 days. There is no customer service to advise you of anything.
reviews.author: Paul A

reviews.title: Just brutal
reviews.text: The customer service is just a joke. The plane will get you there but if you expect customer service at any level you will be disappointed.
reviews.author: Daniel B

reviews.title: Terrible air carrier
reviews.text: We booked the trip in November to go to Cuba, original flight times were leaving at 9am arriving at 1240pm. Then we were rescheduled to leaving at 615pm arriving at 10pm. We had to accept this change which was not nice,we were not able to leave Toronto until 9pm and arrived in Varadero aftet midnight. Got to our hotel at 115am. Retutn trip was even more of a nightmare as we had to stand in que for 4 hours before they checked the flight baggage. This was done so that we could be processed through immigration before midnight and avoid having to put the flight in a hotel for the evening. Then we were put in the depature area and provided a cheese bun and a pop as the complimentary meal. Stores closed and washrooms were closed except for one in the center of the lounge. We were held in the departure area for another 4hours and 45minutes till we boarded the aircraft. Landed in Toronto at 8am and then sat in the plane on the tarmac waiting for a gate to go to, another 45 min. Originally we were supposed to have returned to Toronto at 140am. So we were 8 hours late and this is why we will never again fly with SWOOP. Terrible airline for following a schedule. Never fly Swoop it can affect your vacation enjoyment.¹
reviews.author: Alexander C

reviews.title: Don’t use Swoop
reviews.text: You literally have to pay for everything including water during flights no joke, leg space is from hell and by the way I paid for the sits with extra leg room. If you are taller that 5.5 expect an uncomfortable experience . On my return flight on Sunday April 30th, from Cancun, I met the most irritating and racist attendant at the check-in counter. She was the supervisor that day, the customer service is abysmal and their organization is terrible. Also if you don’t pay for check prepare to put you “personal bag underneath your sit “that already has no leg room” Lastly, the flights never take off on time, never but they will get you to you destination early. That’s about the only compliment there is really. Never again.
reviews.author: Nnamdi U

reviews.title: Swoop travels
reviews.text: Honestly not sure why people are so upset with Swoop. Things happen that are out of anyone control and everyone is so quick to jump on a negative bandwagon. Maybe if more people had respect for what fly crews have to deal with and uncertainties that may arise then maybe we can all fly with alittle less hassel. We flew to Cuba out of Toronto and back home with Swoop. The crew were absolutely amazing. Asked the pilots the departure and arrival we were taking and were happy to answer. On the way home I was not feeling the greatest and the flight attendants were so generous to give me a free bottle of water due to them closing the payment system. Also the overheads were so full out carry on didnt fit above. They checkedour bag in free if charge and had it waiting for us at the gate in Toronto. I thanked them on the way off and told them I would fly Swoop again. We were able to pack for a full week in one carry on avoiding checked fees. The most important thing we made it to our destinations safetly and under control by highly qualitfied individuals. What else could you ask for low budget to get you to your destination. As long as I am treated with respect I give respect and understand sometimes you cant control things. Plan ahead and always be aware of the uncontrolable. Cant wait to choose Swoop again.
reviews.author: Tyler R

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: We had the worst experience flying with swoop. It’s the first time and the last time. We got boarded on to the flight to Edmonton and the capital tells us the flight is going to Mexico. How can this happen? Then we were told there’s a maintenance issue, which it’s obviously a lie. The communication in this company is horrible. The flight is delayed for 5 hours without any compensation.
reviews.author: Chiang M

reviews.title: worst experience ever
reviews.text: My friend and I had a terrible first experience with Swoop. It was supposed to be a 3 hour flight from Varadero to Toronto which ended up being a 12 hour experience. The flight was delayed by 3 hours; it was scheduled to take off at 11pm and it ended up departing at 2am. When we arrived in Toronto we were told that we had to wait on the plane for one hour until Toronto Customs arrived at 6am. A fight broke out on the plane, it was hot, everyone was tired and there was further delays. We then had to wait for the police to arrive for the assault. The steward had not advised the airport that we needed a wheelchair and we waiting again. It was the worst flight experience ever. Do not be enticed by the low fares. It was not worth it.
reviews.author: ann w

reviews.title: Great experience with Swoop - 1st time with Swoop
reviews.text: First time flying Swoop and based on reviews had low expectations, but was pleasantly surprised! -Check-in fast and easy -for a family of 4 paid for 2 bags and brought 3 backpacks as our personal items with -no issue - Flights were on time with a minor delay on the way home - no big deal - staff was friendly, plane was well kept with plenty of leg room
reviews.author: Dreamer

reviews.title: Never Fly This Airline
reviews.text: Booked a trip to Vegas for April 22nd, our flight started out delayed by 20 mins due to how they were boarding the plane. We got on the plane and onto the tarmac after sitting on the for over an hour they tell us our flight will be delayed 1-2 hours because vegas was refusing our flight. After another hour they told us we needed to deboard the plane. It wasn't until we deboarded they told us our flight was canceled. We has booked a hotel through them for the Saturday we were supposed to arrive. They refused to cancel it or refund in. Think you can work this out with customer service? Nope....they don't have anyone you can call....everything goes to a chat bot and a messaging system. One phone number I was able to find I called it, and they hung up on me after I tried to tell them the issue.
reviews.author: Melissa B

reviews.title: Do not use swoop - go elsewhere
reviews.text: Flight crew is good, they are pleasant and kind. It’s a shame their customer service centre and company ruin what could be a good experience. Customer support and the company does not care about their clients. Multiple delays and cancellations only to find they have closed our hotel reimbursement ticket. If you are subject to delay, they will not honour their requirements and alter facts to avoid traveller support requirements.
reviews.author: Jeannette M

reviews.title: Worst Airline
reviews.text: Our bags were delayed for over 2 hours before we could get them. Every airline that came after us got their bags and left while we waited and nobody told us anything. We didn't find anybody to talk to for an hour. We found the supervisor and she was very rude when we asked her about her bags. She said she was clueless as to why it was delayed. She later walked out on us.
reviews.author: princess d

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: The staff at the check-in points were very rude and racist. They had no sympathy that I was traveling with a child and were being very unhelpful. My luggage got damaged by the flight when I got to Cancun also.
reviews.author: princess d

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: My flight was over 9 hours late with no reason given. A couple of employee said they didn't think they had a flight crew. Could not reach anyone in customer service. Swoop gave zero compensation and then blamed it on unscheduled maintenance. They also took 6 weeks to respond to my emails. I'll never fly with swoop again.
reviews.author: Mark L

reviews.title: WORST experience of our lives
reviews.text: Flying back home from PVR we discovered at check in that my 5 years olds passport had expired during our 10 days in PVR & the woman made it her life’s goal to prevent us from going home, even tho it was in her power to let us board the plane. I was forced to stay with the daughter & send my husband and 2 year old son home without us (as we were all crying and traumatized) to stay and deal with embasssy BS to get my 5 year old a temporary day passport AND brand new flights home with WestJet (even tho she had a passport that has liyerally just expired passport days before, birth certificate, care card , and both parents present). When we got home 4 days later, after experiencing hell trying to get back home, the border patrol people in vancouver told us she could have let us board with the ID’s we had no problem, she was just choosing to be difficult. She was SO unhelpful, laughing at my children and I crying, begging her to just let us board our flight HOME. Laughing. Why keep us in Mexico?? Just let us go back home and let our country deal with our expired passport. We spent so much money to undo this psychopath’s decision to keep us from boarding our flight. We will NEVER fly with swoop again. We will tell everyone about the experience. WestJet owns swoop, which sucks because we still ended up supporting the same business, but we had to get home to my baby who was dying from the shocking separation. Worst experience of our lives
reviews.author: Zous B

reviews.title: Swoop
reviews.text: Great overall experience from check-in to picking up our bags! Great friendly service all around! The fees do add up that’s the only negative but I think this is with every airline now!
reviews.author: Marie M

reviews.title: Swoop airlines
reviews.text: Very bad service. My flight was supposed to depart at 11:10 am but it got delayed 3 times and finally departed at 1:46 pm. It was not very cheap either. A one way flight costed me 119 cad. Very disappointed.
reviews.author: Shamjida Zaman L

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Worst airline I've ever taken. Was late both ways over two hours going to punta cana over an hour late coming home. Food was awful. No tvs to watch no blankets to buy. The only good thing are the flight attendance they are very nice. I would never take this airline again if I can avoid it.
reviews.author: Laura D

reviews.title: Worst Experience in 30 years of Travel!
reviews.text: Missed flight and lost day of holiday, damaged luggage, long delays on baggage/rescheduled flight to and from destination, collection of money for transfer to resort when paid for... This whole experience was made worse by the fact it isn't low cost really after you add everything tacked on afterwards. More concerning is the lack of any communication when things go wrong. I'm fully aware things can and do go wrong but Swoop/WestJet have done nothing to make any of it right. In 30 years of travel, the worst experience has been this Swoop/WestJet monstrosity hands down.
reviews.author: FellowTraveler795008

reviews.title: Worse airline ever
reviews.text: This is the worse airline to travel.. had a better choice would never use they service... cheap but service is the worse
reviews.author: Alix

reviews.title: Canceled flight in Cancun - No refund
reviews.text: Wish i would have read the reviews before going with Swoop as Expedia had recommended to us (visiting the most expensive resort in Mexico and taking the cheapest airline?!?) The good: Nice flight attendants, newish aircraft The bad: Uncomfortable thin cushion seats. For for us on our return flight from Cancun, several hours delay, made people board/leave the shuttle bus 3 times before finally canceling the flight. We then had to scramble to find a flight that costs alot more to get back to YYZ, go through customs again and take our luggage back and check in again and after walking several kms had to go to another terminal. After emailing them and filing a refund request, they refused to refund anything at all. A pilot in the washroom told me, since they have very limited staff and limited aircraft, they do not have the flexibility and resources to make alternative flights for their customers. Will never take the chance to fly with this airline again. Ended up costing way more in the end. I guess if you are lucky, things may work out for you?
reviews.author: JimboAlogo

reviews.title: Luggage Issues
reviews.text: My wife and I traveled to Nevada for a six day holiday flying Swoop. We had heard of issues with their flights being delayed and canceled, however, we looked at flight time departures and their schedule aligned with what we were looking for. Pricing was not a factor in our selection process. The trip down was perfect. Except for the couple who checked their baggage but never made it to the check in at the plane. Delay was caused by the requirements to remove their luggage. Approx 45 minutes. This is not a Swoop issue. The return flight is where issues started to present, First delay was an “operational” cause approx 1 hour. Second delay was a “Customs and Immigration “ issue that was never explained. We left Vegas and flew to YYZ Toronto, it was a good flight. At this point I should note that Swoop needs to stop advertising that the have in flight WiFi is it is clearly not available and even if it is available is not capable of streaming any video services. Upon arriving in Toronto, we cleared Customs quickly and headed to our luggage carousel. our flight showed on the board stated our luggage was in transit. The time was 8:20PM. We patiently waited for 30 Minutes or so. No luggage, we started to look look for a Swoop agent who is supposed to be available in the luggage area. We could not find an agent anywhere in the luggage area. We had the agent paged twice and other passengers were having the paged often! When we finally located the agent, it was when our luggage was being offloaded onto a different luggage carousel. 2 1/2 hours after landing, when we inquired why delay we did not get a clear answer. We asked where she had been as there were not updated even once regarding the delay in getting our Luggage. Being in a Customer service industry myself, you can never underestimate the value of communication! We will be issuing a complaint with Swoop directly. I think it was poor customer service to just let an entire plane stand waiting for over 2 hours without any updates! We request the agents name and she stated that she wanted to remain “anonymous”!!! It was not a good ending to our trip. It will definitely affect our future travel plans and who we use for our travel. Non present Swoop agents and no phone numbers available to call does not bode well for future travel with Swoop!
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.title: DON'T FLY SWOOP. The discount isn't worth them ripping you off!
reviews.text: Don'f Fly swoop!!! They canceled our flight "due to weather". the weather was perfect. they were the only ones that canceled, every other airline was still flying. we even hopped on a flight with Air Canada same day. Swoop won't refund the money or give a credit. That is pure theft. plain and simple. The WORST AIRLINE EVER!!!
reviews.author: David O

reviews.title: Matt
reviews.text: Not only was the plane dirty and disgusting but they took items from my bag and lost them. When confronted they gave me the run around for an hour to 7 people and at that time told me they lost my items. Thanks jerks!!!
reviews.author: Matt B

reviews.title: Scammed of my money by Swoop.
reviews.text: The worst airline ever!!! I rate them a zero!! Imagine paying for a luggage online and had to pay again to check the same luggage and they wouldn't refund the previous payment that was already made. They are not professional but a bunch of scammers! I personally and my family and friends will never use this airline again. People beware! I hope no one else will be scammed of their money by this disgusting airline called swoop!!!
reviews.author: nickola s

reviews.title: NOT worth savings. It's a JOKE!
reviews.text: Horrible service, from airport check-in to onboard the flight to customer service afterward. I won't bore you with all the details, I'll give you a quick summary here and advise you not to get fooled by the "discount" rate and even if you have to pay a couple of bucks more, it's well worth it! - They nickel and dime you on EVERYTHING, including charging you for your carry-on. You are thirsty onboard the plane? well pay up for water or wait to get to your destination, and so on... you add it up and it's not much of a saving if at all! - PAID to have a carry-on, then due to a shoulder injury had to check in instead (couldn't lift my suitcase to put in the overhead)... instead of charging me the difference, they made me pay the entire amount for check-in and told me to reach out to customer service for a refund of carry-on fee. - Customer service is a JOKE. No phone number, you have to reach them via Facebook Messenger, takes them days to respond to half your questions... which makes a simple conversation overly tedious, they are rude and impatient and they don't give you their names... just their initials! No wonder, they are hiding behind anonymity. - Customer service basically told me too bad, no refunds... even though they made me pay TWICE for ONE bag (first as a carry-on, then as a checked bag) - Seats are uncomfortable, no video on my flight, if you like wondering if you're plane will make it to its destination, look no further. I will NEVER fly with them (or Westjet for that matter) again. First and last time. To Management, if you had any sense of running a business, you'd value your customers and not take advantage of them when they are vulnerable, nickel and dime them and rip them off. If your value proposition is that we are an affordable way to travel, then you have live by that or people will see what you're all about.
reviews.author: RZ

reviews.title: Support Low Cost airlines and they will deliver
reviews.text: Can’t beat the prices!! Only way to travel to Caribbean and Baja. Booking is great. Only problem is if you pay for a set of luggage choices. You’re locked in.
reviews.author: AshM

reviews.title: Awful!
reviews.text: Terrible! Customer service sucks! Lost my carry on since they insisted I put it in with checked luggage just because wheels stuck out a little and I’ve been flying for a long time and I’ve always used that as my carry on. There’s no phone number to contact anyone, there’s still no update, they told me they’ll get back to me in three days since it was a domestic flight. How hard is it to reply to ONE of my emails at least. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!! Staff was awful because it was late night and they wanted to go home. What about me ? I just flew in for a week and I have no change of clothes and a two hour drive ahead. AWFUL!
reviews.author: Amy A

reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text: We have been sitting on the plane for over 45 minutes as they keep waiting for people who are late. We are now going to be late for our day. We should of slept in know this plane will wait for all late passengers until they decide to come Plane feels like it is falling apart
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Bad online service
reviews.text: Booked a round trip to PVR which was later cancelled by the airline. Gave us 2 option 1 being changing the flight to different days and the option for the days were leaving and returning on the same day( the website only should that option and the other days were completely booked). Which is honestly not an option. And the second was take a refund, in which case I lose money on the hotel cost I had booked for my trip which is thousands of dollars since the trip was for 16 people. I tried calling swoop to see if they would get me a flight on the partner airlines only to find out their customer service number is “no longer taking phone calls” and the only way to contact them is to massage them through social media. Which I did messaged them through Facebook where I talked to the chatbot before asking to be transferred to a “ human colleague”. It’s been 4 days and I am still waiting on the “ human colleague”, out of the 14 day time frame they gave me to decide what to do I wasted 4 waiting for a response. In the meantime I had to drive to the airport that swoop flies out of near me 1.5 hrs away to talk to an actual person. now the service at the airport was wonderful I had a swoop worker help for hours as well as someone from their partnered airline westjet. I can not compliment swoop for those 2 individuals because in no way were they obligated to help for so long but they did so out of their own kindness. Swoop needs to find a better way for their customers to get a hold of them without having to waste so much of their time.
reviews.author: Harshiga R

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE IN HISTORY
reviews.text: I WILL NEVER EVER EVER EVER FLY WITH THIS SCAM AIRLINE AGAIN. First of all you will NEVER get any human being to talk to!!! And when you do get a human being after 12 hours of searching the human being is COMPLETELY USELESS AND CANT HELP YOU. I booked a flight and wanted to cancel as it was under 24 hours of booking. They won't give me my refund!!!! I AM LIVID and want my $900 back I will gladly spend more money to pay a lawyer to sue this airline because they don't honour their "we will give you full refund if you cancel within 24 hours. I have been trying all day to cancel since it had only been 8 hours since I booked and they pretty much won't give me a refund. I can't even get anyone to help me and when I message Facebook its a stupid robot I'm talking to. BE WARNED AND RUN FAR FAR AWAY FROM THIS TRASH SCAMMING AIRLINE. NEGATIVE A MILLION STARS JUST THROW THE WHOLE COMPANY AWAY. I am escalating this to department of transportation agency.
reviews.author: Stephanie Nash

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We paid extra for extra leg room seats, then when we boarded we were told that they had switched planes and our seats were no longer extra leg room. Contacted swoop for a refund and they refused because “it’s up to you what extras you buy”. ???? To add: because this happened on our departing flight, we made sure to confirm with the check in agents on our returning flight that our seats were, in fact, extra leg room seats as we had paid for. They said yes they were. They were not. So in other words, they sold us seats that didn’t exist and then refused to refund the upgrade price. Also, both our departing and returning flights were delayed, shaving an entire day off of our vacation.
reviews.author: CA-traveller

reviews.title: Cheap and no customer service
reviews.text: Swoop nickel and dimes their customers in the most ridiculous ways. Have you ever been charged for water on an airline? No tv. No carry-ons. But the worst was when we bought 3 bags and they auto associates us two adults and one child. When I cancelled my flight we could net keep the bag that was associated with me. We had to pay for another bag. Supremely annoying. I will try to avoid swoop in the future.
reviews.author: Katrin

reviews.title: GREAT experience
reviews.text: I was so hesitant to book a trip that had swoop as the airline but boy was I wrong. Swoop exceeded my expectations. We left toronto on time and landed early! The flight attendants were SO friendly. One lady I think her name is Kaisha- or something like that deserves a raise for her friendliness and excitement. On board snacks were affordable and delicious. Even had wifi!!! Same for my return flight, the same girl was working and was great. We left on time, and again landed early. We had free carry ons with our package and I paid for one checked bag. I tell everyone how great it was because I know the reputation Swoop has. I have flown lots of times with other big name companies and have faced countless delays, baggage loss etc- and this was by far my most smooth experience. Always remember people who have good experiences don’t always leave reviews- only the bad ones typically get left so hopefully this gives some reassurance and will reduce some stress for you. I will be flying swoop again:)
reviews.author: Haylee H

reviews.title: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.text: First and last time flying with swoop. The WORST airline ever, kept receiving emails that my flight was delayed with a new time every time they emailed, just to end up at the airport and they sent another email saying the flight was cancelled. TRASH TRASH TRASH. The customer service is worse, couldn’t even give me a proper answer no compensation for the additional money I had to spend on Uber, hotel & food. It’s better to just spend more money and have a reliable airline with customer service reps who know what they’re doing and can effectively assist you. Anytime my flight was cancelled with other airlines they would make accommodations for food, hotel & transportation until the rescheduled flight, but swoop told me to basically figure it out. DON’T SPEND YOUR MONEY WITH THEM If I could rate below 1 I would
reviews.author: Shelly

reviews.title: “It’s the way she goes”- never flying Swoop again
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend were flying to St Johns to surprise our friend for his birthday. Our original flight was booked for a Thursday morning at 6am. We live 4 1/12 hours from the airport one way. We drove through the night to make the flight. At 4:35am (same day 1 1/2 hours before take off) they cancelled our flight. They rescheduled our flight for Saturday (2 days later). We asked for a refund because all of our plans were for the Friday, they told us because we had a “rescue flight” rescheduled for us they weren’t entitled to give us a refund. We drove home the same day so did 9 hours of driving. They won’t refund our flight or carry on because they rescheduled a flight for us even though it’s now no longer convenient or meets the needs of our trip. So now we can drive another 4 1/2 hours on Saturday and still go for the difference of our trip or cut our losses and not go at all. We asked if they could put us on a Westjet flight on the Friday and we’re told no because we can’t change airports and because they’ve provided a “rescue flight” (a flight 2 days later). They also don’t have a customer service number you have to chat with someone online. The person we spoke with online was not understanding and we have now not been provided any compensation or apology. It’s just crazy that they can cancel our flight and not compensate just because they provided another flight 2 days later. We purchase tickets based off of our lives and plans that we’ve made and to just cancel it an hour before take off and say it’s okay because of a “rescue flight” is unacceptable, shocking, and costs money for the people flying. The lack of compassion and understanding is shocking. I’m not trying to b*tch but just let people know what happened in case your considering using this airline. Yes it’s cheap, but they apparently only fly when they want to. Incredibly disappointing.

reviews.title: Worst airline ever! Do not book with them
reviews.text: The entire experience with Swoop was unpleasant. Our departure flight was cancelled 8 hrs prior to leaving, due to weather when the weather was sunny and dry. There were No other flight cancellations to our destination other than Swoop. We were not informed that the flight was fully cancelled and got an email saying that it was delayed and we would get an email with a new time. We never got a email, Westjet was no help and deflected and we were not informed when the flight was rebooked the next day. The flight home was the only carrier with a delay which ended up arriving at 1:30 am!! I lost a full day off our vacation and now another half day coming home. The planes are old, run down and you have to pay for everything little thing. They don’t even offer water. Do yourself a favour and book your travel with a professional carrier that is organized and reliable. I will never book Swoop again.

reviews.title: DO NOT TRAVEL WITH SWOOP
reviews.text: Our flight was continuously delayed for a variety of reasons. It arrived late, they had to do a search on the plane, flight attendants walked off because they worked the maximum amount of hours due to all the delays. Once they said we were boarding and we were in line, they cancelled the flight. The swoop attendants sent us on a goose chase, telling us to go xyz for information- then no representatives were there. Kept waiting until they finally did show up, only to tell us that they will not be reimbursing hotels because the flight was cancelled due to weather. Before this we received emails from swoop saying it was cancelled due to customs and immigration. I showed this email to the representative and she called her supervisor, only to say they still won’t be compensating for hotels because the flight rescheduling was out of their control. All in all- DO NOT BOOK WITH SWOOP. SPEND THE EXTRA MONEY AND BOOK WITH A RELIABLE ANS REPUTABLE AIRLINE. Swoop did not answer any questions, help the passengers in anyway, toyed with us with multiple delays and cancellation last minute. No compensation for an error on their part. The flight was not canceled due to weather because other flights were still taking off. This was a human error on their end but they are not taking responsibility or accountability for the delay and cancellation, that left a lot of people stuck in the airport without any accommodations. Trash air line.

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVER SAVE YOUR MONEY!! GOT SCAMMED ON EXTRA INSURANCE
reviews.text: WORST AIRLINE EVER SAVE YOUR MONEY!!! daughter was due to come home on Dec 19/ 22 had to cancel on the 15th due to a death, called in to Swoop they said they couldn't refund , would only refund one way but if we bought extra cancellation insurance for an extra $383.23 they would give us a full refund , they said it would take up to 45 days to see the credit back on our card and today is MARCH 10 /23 85 days later and we are still fighting with them so now we are out the flight plus the extra $383.23 that they SCAMMED off of us, NO customer service help at all!! ,they pass us on to the number that sold us the extra insurance and half the time they never answer, we have to use different phones so someone will answer.
